fields.headline: I'm tired of life *lifing*. Not in crisis. Just tired.
The kind of tired a nap doesn't touch. Too many fights with too many *systems*.
My body's been loud lately, and when my body's loud, my mind *follows*.
They were never separate. Stress shows up in my shoulders. Pain shows up in my *mood*.
So today I'm not fixing anything. I'm letting myself *feel* it.
Where it sits: heavy chest, tight jaw, a body that wants the *couch*.
Naming it doesn't make it disappear. It just stops it from running the *show*.
Tired isn't failing. Tired is information about how much you've been *carrying*.
Sunday doesn't have to be a reset. It can just be a *rest*.
You can be tired of life lifing and still be glad you're *here* for it.
Send this to someone who's been running on *empty*.
Start with *feel*.
fields.text: Before you fix, plan or push through, notice what you're actually feeling and where it lives in your body. There's an app for that.
fields.strip: Free to start. Link in bio.
